n, base = map(int, input().split())
digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % base)
    n //= base

result = 0
total_shift = sum(digits)

for i in range(len(digits)):
    total_shift -= digits[i]
    for j in range(digits[i] - 1, -1, -1):
        if i == 0:
            result = (result * base + (total_shift + j) % base)
        else:
            result = result * base + (total_shift + j) % base

print(result % 1000000007)
